selection_rationale.Roland_voices: Correct the demonstrated idle-dependent saw/pulse phase mismatch using one free-running oscillator phase, without changing existing filters, mixer gains, presets or envelope controls. Juno-60 begins from PR83 v1, not PR89.
selection_rationale.Mini: Retain the original stable v1. Bounded real-Model-D saw comparisons do not justify replacing it with the more complex v3. The v3 numerical repair remains a separate experiment.

rejected_or_unselected.juno-60/pr89-0b98748d: Owner sonic rejection; never selected for this freeze.
rejected_or_unselected.minimoog/v2: Confirmed high-cutoff held-note collapse; engineering fixture only.
rejected_or_unselected.minimoog/v3: Numerically repaired, but no demonstrated whole-instrument sonic advantage over v1. Retained as an experiment.

remaining_limits: Reference results are identified component and stable-note comparisons, not complete panel, envelope, gain or multi-unit calibration.
The Juno-106 dry held note changes timbre over time. A static preset is not a reconstruction of that movement, and its cause is not established.
SH-101 recordings are physical-hardware MP3 factory-patch examples; capture-chain and exact panel metadata are incomplete. Resonance/output calibration is not established by a shape-only score.
The selected Mini bass reference contains significant even partials and temporal variation not matched by the isolated-square hypothesis; that failed comparison remains visible.
Fresh owner listening to the coherent Roland versions and CURLOP runtime qualification remain separate gates.
consumer: CURLOP loads the single Faust script and generates the faceplate. No manual binding or GUI changes. Performance protocol: curlcomplex/CURLOP#313 and PR314.
change_policy: Do not edit these frozen source bytes in place. A later sound change creates a new version and a new reviewed freeze identity. Existing saved sound versions remain intact.
